**Replaced rule:** The older errors-by-field body. Source: `policy-error-response.md`, which says the new object "replaces the older errors-by-field body."

**Old values as the code has them today** (Source: `code-error-shape.md`, bytes 108-503):
- Validation: status 422 with `{"errors":{"body":["can't be blank"]}}`
- Missing or bad token: 401 with `{"status":"error","message":"missing authorization credentials"}`
- Other errors: 500 with the error message as the body

The excerpts don't show whether the app has adopted the new object shape yet, so the code may still use the old format.

> # Soft delete rule (demo policy)
>
> This is a demo policy for this repo, not behaviour of the app.
>
> Deleting a comment sets a deletedAt timestamp and keeps the row. Comments with a deletedAt value are left out of comment lists. Only the comment author may delete a comment.

- **Soft-delete field:** `deletedAt`
- **Value that marks a deleted row:** a deletedAt timestamp value, which the delete sets. The note does not name a literal value beyond that.
- **Reads exclude deleted rows:** yes. Comments with a deletedAt value are left out of comment lists.
- **Replaced an earlier rule?** The excerpts do not say. The note contains no replacement statement.

The feature-3 spec still lists this rule as blocked, but the note's text is in the retrieved excerpts, so the spec's open items can be answered from it.
